qa_flags.question: 分析師 Scott Deuschle 追問與 Rolls-Royce SMR 蒸汽產生器合約的 shipset 金額拆分
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 未給具體數字，只重申落在既有 SMR $50-100M 區間中段，拒絕拆分揭露

qa_flags.question: 分析師 Andre Madrid 追問 Westinghouse $80 billion 核電夥伴案中 BWXT 可能捕獲的具體規模
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 直接表示尚未給出具體指引規模；CEO 補充僅描述機會類型（組件製造）但同樣未量化

qa_flags.question: 分析師 Scott Deuschle 追問是否會因歐洲勞斯萊斯 SMR 需求而在當地新建製造據點
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 僅答『正在評估、確實有在考慮』，未證實是否設廠、未給時程或規模

qa_flags.question: Is there any update on when we could see approval of Tech 99.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 未給時間表，強調「imperfect clarity」，反覆提到產品品質/過濾濃縮問題仍在解決中，尚未向 FDA 送件；且連續數季重複「not much new」的措辭

qa_flags.question: William Blair analyst asks what could help solve/de-risk balance-of-plant and nuclear-island EPC delivery, pressing for how government could step in.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO twice restates/reframes the question back to the analyst ('Again, you're talking about delivery risk for the balance of plant in the nuclear island, Jed.') rather than answering directly; analyst has to re-ask before getting a general, non-specific answer that EPC delivery is 'a problem the Bechtels and Fluors of the world are going to have to solve.'

qa_flags.question: Deutsche Bank analyst asks whether Kinectrics has direct exposure to high-voltage data center build-out.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO admits lack of specific knowledge ('I don't know the details on that. I suspect that we do.') rather than confirming with a concrete answer.
